script.title: MOVE-OUT WALKTHROUGH
script.story_hook: The final walkthrough decides your deposit.
script.intro_zh: 最後的點交，決定押金能退多少。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to your move-out walkthrough today. Listen for useful cleaning phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到今天的退租點交場景。留意實用的清潔說法。
script.outro: That's a smooth move-out! Keep every receipt safe.
script.outro_zh: 多順利的退租點交！收據都要收好。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat ten useful lines.
script.practice_intro_zh: 接下來，我們逐句跟讀這些實用句子。
script.char_a_description: a young woman in her late twenties with shoulder-length dark brown hair, wearing an olive green hoodie, black leggings and white sneakers, slim build and a cheerful smile
script.char_b_description: a middle-aged man with short gray hair and a neat beard, wearing a navy blue polo shirt, khaki pants and brown work boots, calm and sturdy

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning! You're here for the walkthrough?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈmɔɹnɪŋ! jəɹ hɪɹ fɚ ðə ˈwɑkθɹu/
dialogue.zh: 早安！您是來做點交的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Morning! Yes, we'll check every room today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɔɹnɪŋ! jɛs wil tʃɛk ˈɛvɹi ɹum təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 早！今天我們會一間間檢查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. I cleaned everything last night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt aɪ klɛnd ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ læst naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我昨晚全部打掃過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice. Do you have all the keys?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs du ju hæv ɑl ðə kiz/
dialogue.zh: 很好。所有鑰匙都在你手上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All five, plus the mailbox key.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑl faɪv plʌs ðə ˈmɛɪlˌbɑks ki/
dialogue.zh: 五把都有，外加信箱鑰匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. Let's start with the kitchen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɚfɪkt lɛts stɑɹt wɪð ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn/
dialogue.zh: 完美。我們從廚房開始吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure. The counters are spotless, see?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ðə ˈkaʊntɚz ɑɹ ˈspɑtlɪs si/
dialogue.zh: 當然。檯面亮晶晶的，您看？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They look great. What about the oven?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ lʊk ɡɹeɪt wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə ˈʌvən/
dialogue.zh: 看起來很棒。爐子狀況如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I scrubbed it twice with warm soap.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ skɹʌbd ɪt twaɪs wɪð wɔɹm soʊp/
dialogue.zh: 我用溫肥皂水刷了兩遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good. Any damage I should know about?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈɛni ˈdæmɪdʒ aɪ ʃʊd noʊ əˈbaʊt/
dialogue.zh: 好。有什麼損壞要讓我知道的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, one small dent near the fridge handle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm wʌn smɑl dɛnt nɪɹ ðə fɹɪdʒ ˈhændəl/
dialogue.zh: 呃，冰箱把手旁有個小凹痕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me note that on the form.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi noʊt ðæt ɑn ðə fɔɹm/
dialogue.zh: 我把這個記在表格上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that going to cost me anything?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə kɑst mi ˈɛniθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 這個會扣我的錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small dents usually don't come off deposits.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑl dɛnts ˈjuʒəwəli doʊnt kʌm ɔf dɪˈpɑzɪts/
dialogue.zh: 小凹痕通常不會從押金裡扣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phew! Okay, how about the living room?
dialogue.phonetic: /fju oʊˈkeɪ haʊ əˈbaʊt ðə ˈlɪvɪŋ ɹum/
dialogue.zh: 呼！好，客廳呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's see. Empty and pretty clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts si ˈɛmemti ænd ˈpɹɪtɪ kliːn/
dialogue.zh: 我看看。空了，也挺乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I painted those scuff marks yesterday.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈpeɪntɪd ðoʊz skʌf mɑɹks ˈjɛstɚdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我昨天把那些刮痕刷掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Really? These spots still show a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɪli ðiz spɑts stɪl ʃoʊ ə ˈlɪtəl/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？這幾處還看得見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no. Will touch-up paint hide them?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ wɪl ˈtʌtʌp peɪnt haɪd ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 噢不。補漆筆蓋得住嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, one more coat should do it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl wʌn mɔɹ koʊt ʃʊd du ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，再刷一層應該就可以了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you like me to fix it now?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju laɪk mi tə fɪks ɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 您要現在就修好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: If you paint today, I won't deduct it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf ju peɪnt təˈdeɪ aɪ woʊnt dɪˈdʌkt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 您今天刷好，我就不扣款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal! I'll grab my brush from the car.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil aɪl ɡɹæb maɪ bɹʌʃ fɹʌm ðə kɑɹ/
dialogue.zh: 成交！我去車上拿油漆刷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great. Now, how does the carpet look?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt naʊ haʊ dʌz ðə ˈkɑɹpɪt lʊk/
dialogue.zh: 好。地毯狀況如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's vacuumed, but there's one stubborn stain.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈvækiumd bʌt ðɛɹz wʌn ˈstʌbɚn steɪn/
dialogue.zh: 吸過塵了，可有一個難清的污漬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check. Hmm, coffee?
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk hʌm ˈkɔfi/
dialogue.zh: 我看看。嗯，咖啡漬？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, last week. I tried everything!
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs læst wiːk aɪ tɹaɪd ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 上週灑的。我什麼方法都試過了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Steam cleaning removes most fresh coffee marks.
dialogue.phonetic: /stim ˈklinɪŋ ɹɪˈmuːvz moʊst fɹɛʃ ˈkɔfi mɑɹks/
dialogue.zh: 蒸汽清潔能去掉多半新鮮咖啡漬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I rent a steamer right away?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ rɛnt ə ˈstimɚ ɹaɪt əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我該立刻租一台蒸汽機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You could, or we charge a flat fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kʊd ɔɹ wi tʃɑɹdʒ ə flæt fi/
dialogue.zh: 也可以，或者我們收固定費用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is your crew's flat fee?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz jʊɹ kɹuz flæt fi/
dialogue.zh: 你們團隊的固定費用多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eighty dollars, booked for tomorrow morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈeɪti ˈdɑlɚz bʊkt fɚ təˈmɑɹoʊ ˈmɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 八十塊，排在明天上午。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Renting one costs about forty, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɛntɪŋ wʌn kɑsts əˈbaʊt ˈfɔɹti aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 自己租大概四十塊，我想。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, so doing it yourself saves money.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt soʊ ˈduɪŋ ɪt jʊɹˈsɛlf seɪvz ˈmʌni/
dialogue.zh: 對，自己處理能省錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But my moving truck arrives at two.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt maɪ ˈmuviŋ tɹʌk əˈɹaɪvz æt tu/
dialogue.zh: 但我的搬家貨車兩點會到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the crew might be worth it.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə kɹu maɪt bi wɜɹð ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 所以請清潔隊可能更划算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're right. Please book the crew today.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ɹaɪt pliz bʊk ðə kɹu təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 你說得對。請今天就訂他們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done. I added the order to your file.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn aɪ əˈdɛdɪd ði ˈɔɹdɚ tə jʊɹ faɪl/
dialogue.zh: 好，訂單已加進你的檔案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks! What's the situation in the bedroom?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks wʌts ðə ˌsɪtʃuˈeɪʃən ɪn ðə ˈbɛdɹum/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！臥室怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Walls look clean. The windows are dusty.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑlz lʊk kliːn ðə ˈwɪndoʊz ɑɹ ˈdʌsti/
dialogue.zh: 牆面很乾淨。窗戶有灰塵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry! I'll wipe them before I leave.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑɹi aɪl waɪp ðɛm bɪˈfɔɹ aɪ liv/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉！我走之前會擦乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That works. Are the blinds yours or ours?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wɜɹks ɑɹ ðə blaɪndz jɔɹz ɔɹ ˈaʊɚz/
dialogue.zh: 可以。百葉窗算你的還是我們的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lease says mounted fixtures stay.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lis sɛz ˈmaʊntɪd ˈfɪkstʃɚz steɪ/
dialogue.zh: 合約寫了，固定装置留在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Correct, so the blinds stay with the unit.
dialogue.phonetic: /kəˈrɛkt soʊ ðə blaɪndz steɪ wɪð ðə ˈjunɪt/
dialogue.zh: 對，百葉窗留在房子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. I'll take only my own curtains.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪl teɪk ˈoʊnli maɪ oʊn ˈkɜɹtənz/
dialogue.zh: 好。我只帶走自己的窗簾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's fair. Now, about your deposit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts fɛɹ naʊ əˈbaʊt jʊɹ dɪˈpɑzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 很公道。再來是押金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When do I get my money back?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn du aɪ ɡɛt maɪ ˈmʌni bæk/
dialogue.zh: 我什麼時候能拿回錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Within thirty days, I'll refund your deposit.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪˈθɪn ˈθɜɹdi deɪz aɪl ɹiˈfʌnd jʊɹ dɪˈpɑzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 三十天內，我會退你的押金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you mail it or send cash?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju meɪl ɪt ɔɹ sɛnd kæʃ/
dialogue.zh: 你們會寄支票還是給現金？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A paper check, plus an itemized list.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈpeɪpɚ tʃɛk plʌs ən ˈaɪtəmˌaɪzd lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 紙本支票，附上細項清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I update my address online later?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ əpˈdeɪt maɪ əˈdrɛs ˈɑnˌlaɪn ˈleɪtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 之後我能線上更新地址嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course. Here's the move-out form.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs hɪɹz ðə muv aʊt fɔɹm/
dialogue.zh: 當然。這是退租表單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll sign it once the windows are done.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl saɪn ɪt wʌns ðə ˈwɪndoʊz ɑɹ dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 窗戶擦完我就簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sounds good. I'll wait right over here.
dialogue.phonetic: /saʊndz ɡʊd aɪl weɪt ɹaɪt ˈoʊvɚ hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 好，我就在那邊等你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, the windows are shining now!
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊz ɑɹ ˈʃaɪnɪŋ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好了，窗戶現在亮得發光！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice work! That wall looks brand new.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs wɜɹk ðæt wɔl lʊks bɹænd nu/
dialogue.zh: 做得好！那面牆像新的一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's the form signed, and all five keys.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹz ðə fɔɹm saɪnd ænd ɑl faɪv kiz/
dialogue.zh: 表單簽好了，五把鑰匙都在。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. I'll text you the receipt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt aɪl tɛkst ju ðə ɹɪˈsit/
dialogue.zh: 收到。我會傳收據給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you! This went better than I hoped.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ðɪs wɛnt ˈbɛtɚ ðæn aɪ hoʊpt/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！這比我想像中順利多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You made it easy. Enjoy the new home!
dialogue.phonetic: /ju meɪd ɪt ˈizi ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðə nu hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 你讓一切很輕鬆。祝新居愉快！

script.youtube_title: 【✨押金全額退回】🎧60句退租點交聽力｜凹痕・污漬・窗戶打掃全都會｜💡不用背多聽就會用｜🌱A2｜Move-Out Inspection
script.youtube_title_en: "I'll Refund Your Deposit" — Passing the Apartment Move-Out Inspection
script.youtube_description:
60句公寓退租點交聽力練習：跟著租客與管理員從廚房查到臥室，一次聽懂凹痕、污漬與押金退款的說法。

這一集是一鏡到底的點交情境，檢查檯面、爐子、地毯與窗戶，遇到刮痕和咖啡漬的小狀況，最後談好修補方式與退款時間。點交、押金、清潔費用等生活單字都在對話裡自然出現。

你會聽到：
- 回報房間狀況與損壞的禮貌說法
- 凹痕和污漬會不會扣押金
- 自己租蒸汽機和請清潔隊的取捨
- 押金何時退、怎麼退、收據怎麼拿

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，把這些句子聽熟、說順。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱頻道，每天一集生活情境英文聽力！
script.youtube_description_en:
60 lines of apartment move-out inspection listening practice: a tenant and a building manager walk through every room, find a dent and a carpet stain, then settle fees, touch-up paint and the deposit refund.

You will hear how to describe damage politely, ask what comes out of a deposit, compare a cleaning crew with renting a steamer, and confirm refund timing and receipts. The second half is line-by-line listening and shadowing.

Perfect for A2 learners: no memorizing, just listen until it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for daily-life English listening practice every week.

script.thumbnail_action: handing over a set of keys
